                    <h4>Job Purpose</h4>
<p>Will lead testing for mainframe-based healthcare claims applications built on COBOL, IMS and DB2.</p>
<h4>Job Description</h4>
<ul>
<li>Understanding claims business requirements and identifying the test scenarios for mainframe applications.</li>
<li>Creating, reviewing and executing test cases for claims processing.</li>
<li>Preparing and managing claims test data in DB2 and IMS.</li>
<li>Running and monitoring JCL batch jobs and validating the output, including claim adjudication and payment results.</li>
<li>Debugging and troubleshooting issues with the development team during testing.</li>
<li>Participating in sprint planning and grooming sessions to understand requirements and ensure good test coverage.</li>
<li>Collaborating with the team and working towards achieving the release goals.</li>
<li>Learning new tools, methodologies and claims domain updates, and adopting best practices.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Duties and Responsibilities</h4>
<ul>
<li>Work with the BA and development teams to understand claims requirements and define the test strategy and test plan.</li>
<li>Lead test planning, estimation and execution for mainframe batch and online claims applications.</li>
<li>Review test cases and claims test data prepared by the team.</li>
<li>Validate claims data in DB2 and IMS databases and verify batch job results, including claim intake, adjudication and payment cycles.</li>
<li>Report defects and track them to closure.</li>
<li>Train and mentor the testing team members.</li>
<li>Identify risks and recommend mitigations as needed.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Specifics</h4>
<ul>
<li>The candidate should have excellent communication skills, strong interpersonal skills and be team oriented</li>
<li>Innovative in proposing/implementing new ideas/processes</li>
<li>Highly motivated and self-starting, should have a proactive approach to resolving issues and working with limited supervision</li>
<li>Ability to quickly learn new testing tools/technology and implement it effectively</li>
<li>To Adhere to ISMS policies and procedures</li>
</ul>

            <h1 class="job-title">Lead AI Engineer – Gen AI</h1>
            
            <div class="job-meta-info">
                <span class="meta-item experience">
                    <strong>Total Experience:</strong> 7+ Years                 </span>
                <span class="meta-item location">
                    <strong>Job Location:</strong> 
                    Kochi, Trivandrum                </span>
            </div>
        </header>

        <div class="job-grid-container">
            <div class="job-left-content">
                <div class="job-description">
                    <p><strong>Notice period : </strong><span data-teams="true">Immediate joiner</span></p>
<h4>Job Purpose</h4>
<p>We are looking for an experienced AI Lead / Senior AI Engineer with 7+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering, solution design, and hands-on development. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem and the ability to identify, design, and develop AI/ML solutions aligned with enterprise application architecture and data strategy.</p>
<p>The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, application teams, data engineers, architects, and technology leadership to identify high-value AI use cases and translate them into scalable, production-read solutions.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on technical leadership role requiring strong solutioning, development, troubleshooting, and communication skills.</p>
<h4>Job Description</h4>
<ul>
<li>Analyze the existing application ecosystem, business processes, and data landscape to identify an recommend relevant AI/ML use cases.</li>
<li>Work with business and technology stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into practical AI/ML solutions.</li>
<li>Lead the solutioning, architecture, development, and implementation of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions.</li>
<li>Design end-to-end AI solutions leveraging the Microsoft Azure AI ecosystem.</li>
<li>Develop hands-on POCs and production-grade AI applications to validate and demonstrate proposed solutions.</li>
<li>Design and implement Generative AI, RAG, LLM, and AI-agent-based solutions based on business requirements.</li>
<li>Evaluate appropriate AI models, frameworks, Azure services, data sources, and integration patterns for each use case.</li>
<li>Collaborate with Data Engineering teams to leverage enterprise data platforms and data pipelines for AI/ML solutions.</li>
<li>Integrate AI capabilities with existing enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and data platforms.</li>
<li>Provide technical leadership and guidance to AI engineers and development teams.</li>
<li>Review solution designs, technical implementations, code, and AI/ML architecture to ensure quality and scalability.</li>
<li>Conduct technical feasibility assessments and define appropriate approaches for AI use cases.</li>
<li>Develop prototypes and POCs to evaluate emerging AI technologies and demonstrate business value.</li>
<li>Establish best practices around prompt engineering, model selection, RAG, evaluation, security, and responsible AI.</li>
<li>Troubleshoot technical challenges related to AI models, data, integrations, application architecture, and deployment.</li>
<li>Work within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, technical discussions, backlog refinement, and solution reviews.</li>
<li>Communicate technical concepts and AI solution recommendations clearly to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.</li>
<li>Adhere to the Information Security Management policies and procedures.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Job Specification</h4>
<ul>
<li>7+ years of experience in AI/ML engineering and/or data science.</li>
<li>Proven experience delivering AI/ML solutions from concept/POC through production.</li>
<li>Strong hands-on development experience with Python.</li>
<li>Strong experience with Microsoft Azure and Azure-based application/data platforms.</li>
<li>Demonstrated experience in AI/ML and Generative AI solutioning.</li>
<li>Experience working with enterprise application and data ecosystems.</li>
<li>Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.</li>
<li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills.</li>
<li>Ability to communicate effectively with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and senior leadership.</li>
<li>Ability to work independently and take ownership of AI solution delivery.</li>
